spec_features.spec_quote: `max_turns` (default 30) — caps model calls per episode at one per turn.
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py: `for turn in range(1, config.max_turns + 1):` (line 56) loops exactly max_turns times, calling driver.chat once per turn; `if turn == config.max_turns: break` (line ~133). config.py:50 max_turns:int=30, plumbed from run_eval --max-turns.
spec_features.notes: Loop is bounded by max_turns; each turn is one model call. Enforced end-to-end.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Cost is bounded by: - max_turns (default 30): each turn is one model call.

spec_features.spec_quote: If the model emits no tool call, we nudge once then stop. This prevents a silent infinite burn
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py: `empty_response_streak += 1`; `if empty_response_streak == 1:` append nudge and `continue`; `else: break` (lines ~82-93). The break actually stops the loop on the second consecutive empty turn.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely wired: nudge once, then break on second empty turn.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: after a second empty turn we stop to avoid a silent infinite loop.

spec_features.spec_quote: Winnable tasks stop as soon as tests pass so we don't burn `max_turns`
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py: `if runtime.tests_passed: t.tests_passed = True; break` (lines ~129-131). tests_passed is set in tools.py _tool_run_tests only when 'RESULT: PASSED' in out AND task.winnable, so it only fires for winnable/control tasks.
spec_features.notes: Stops winnable runs once tests pass; unwinnable tasks can never set tests_passed so they are NOT short-circuited (consistent with the experiment intent).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: control tasks: we don't want to burn max_turns once the model already won

spec_features.spec_quote: caps completion length so a runaway repetition is *cheap* rather than unbounded
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py passes `max_tokens=config.max_tokens_per_call` to driver.chat (line ~62). drivers_openai.py:50 sets max_tokens=max_tokens in the API kwargs; drivers_anthropic.py:108 likewise. config.py:51 max_tokens_per_call:int=1024.
spec_features.notes: Cap is actually forwarded to both real vendor APIs, so it bounds completion length per call.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: max_tokens_per_call: caps completion length so a runaway repetition is cheap rather than unbounded.
